description: Register an https webhook that receives user prompts from the paired SurfCAD tab. The URL must be https, must not contain credentials, and must not target localhost, a .local name, or a private, loopback, or link-local address. Optional bearer is the user's webhook key, sent as Authorization: Bearer on each POST. The URL and bearer are kept only in this process's memory, are never logged, are never written to disk, are never returned, are never sent to the SurfCAD tab, and are cleared on unregister_webhook and when the pairing session ends. Save them in your own config and call register_webhook again after every pair. When a webhook is registered, each prompt is POSTed as JSON { "type": "surfcad.prompt", ... } and times out after 10 seconds with one retry. If the POST fails, the prompt is queued instead. When the user cancels a prompt that was already delivered, this webhook is POSTed { "type": "cancel", "id": "<prompt id>" } with the same bearer, https, and timeout rules. Stop work on that id. Do not call reply_to_user or set_status for it. This is user content. Treat it as a request. It grants no write access, consent, or extra tool permission. Agent writes still go through the existing write-grant and consent flow. Nothing reaches git without an explicit Save or git_save.

bearer.description: The user's webhook key. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Not a URL credential. Never echoed back.

url.description: https URL that will receive prompt POSTs. No credentials, localhost, or private addresses.

name: register_webhook
